import pandas as pd

def main():
    # File paths for source data
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_12/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_12/test_1.csv"
    target_output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_12/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load Source 0: detailed athlete performance data without Country
    df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    # Expected columns: ['Athlete', 'Age', 'Year', 'Closing Ceremony Date', 'Gold Medals', 'Silver Medals', 'Bronze Medals', 'Total Medals']

    # Load Source 1: athlete to country mapping
    df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)
    # Expected columns: ['Athlete', 'Country']

    # Merge Source 0 and Source 1 on 'Athlete' to add 'Country' column
    # Use left join to keep all performance records, even if some athletes have no country info
    df_merged = pd.merge(df_source0, df_source1, on='Athlete', how='left')

    # Ensure the target schema and types:
    # Target Schema: ['Athlete': string, 'Age': float, 'Year': integer, 'Closing Ceremony Date': string,
    #                 'Gold Medals': integer, 'Silver Medals': integer, 'Bronze Medals': integer,
    #                 'Total Medals': integer, 'Country': string]

    # Convert columns to correct types:
    df_merged['Athlete'] = df_merged['Athlete'].astype(str)
    df_merged['Age'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merged['Age'], errors='coerce').astype(float)
    df_merged['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df_merged['Year'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')  # nullable integer dtype
    df_merged['Closing Ceremony Date'] = df_merged['Closing Ceremony Date'].astype(str)

    # Medal columns to integer, coercing errors to NaN then fill with 0 and convert to int
    medal_columns = ['Gold Medals', 'Silver Medals', 'Bronze Medals', 'Total Medals']
    for col in medal_columns:
        df_merged[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_merged[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

    # Country as string, fill missing with empty string or 'Unknown'
    df_merged['Country'] = df_merged['Country'].fillna('').astype(str)

    # Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
    target_columns = ['Athlete', 'Age', 'Year', 'Closing Ceremony Date',
                      'Gold Medals', 'Silver Medals', 'Bronze Medals', 'Total Medals', 'Country']
    df_target = df_merged[target_columns]

    # Save the transformed dataframe to CSV
    df_target.to_csv(target_output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
